hero.label: Direction Two
hero.title: EURASIA → TÜRKİYE
hero.subtitle: For Eurasian companies seeking reliable partners, buyers and distribution channels in Türkiye.

intro.heading: Bringing Eurasian Products into Türkiye
intro.paragraph: Türkiye is one of the largest and most dynamic consumer markets in the region, with a young population, strong retail networks and growing industrial demand. For Eurasian producers it represents a real opportunity, but entering it without local knowledge is slow and uncertain. We help companies from across Eurasia identify the right Turkish partners, understand regulatory and certification requirements, and build a market entry plan that turns opportunity into actual sales.

items.title: Strategic Location
items.description: A bridge between Europe, Asia and the Middle East with fast logistics to every major market.

items.title: Growing Consumer Market
items.description: A young, large and active consumer base with strong demand across multiple sectors.

items.title: Reliable Legal Framework
items.description: Clear commercial law and stable regulations that protect foreign investors and traders.

items.title: Skilled Workforce
items.description: An experienced industrial and commercial workforce across every major sector.

steps.title: Initial Consultation
steps.description: We understand your product, goals and constraints, then assess fit with the Turkish market.

steps.title: Local Partner & Distributor Search
steps.description: We identify and vet Turkish distributors, buyers and partners suited to your offering.

steps.title: Market Entry Planning
steps.description: We map regulatory, certification and logistics requirements into a concrete entry plan.

steps.title: Launch & Ongoing Support
steps.description: We support the launch and stay engaged to grow the channel after go-live.

cta.heading: Ready to enter the Turkish market?
